title: Lazy Sunday Croatian Chinese Broccoli Bake
description: A vegan-friendly Croatian dish featuring Chinese broccoli, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a springy texture from fermented ingredients. This bake combines the flavors of Croatia with the convenience of a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped Chinese broccoli to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked broccoli, sauerkraut, vegan cheese shreds, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Stir in the nutritional yeast and whole wheat breadcrumbs.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and drizzle with lemon juice.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
